<div class="container">
<div class="row">
<div class="col-xs-12 col-sm-8">
<div class="hero__body">
<h1 class="module__title module__title--bold module__title--none">Meeting global demand for diverse resources in Russian, Chinese and dozens of other languages</h1> </div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="row hero-header__message-wrap">
<div class="col-xs-12">
<div class="hero-header__message hero-header__message--cookies" id="cookieMessage" style=""><span class="message__close glyphicon glyphicon-remove"></span> <h6 class="message__title">Use of Cookies</h6> <div class="message__content"><p>By navigating on the East View website, you agree to our use of cookies during your browsing experience. Learn more about our cookies policy <a href="/cookies-policy/">here</a>.</p></div></div>

<div class="module">
<div class="module__content-column">
<div class="container">
<div class="module__inner">
<div class="row column__blocks row-flex">
<div class="col-xs-12 col-md-8">
<div class="module__content module__content--image-red module--inverted" style="background-image: url(https://www.eastview.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/GPA_masthead_website_v3-1024x289.jpg);">
<div class="module__inner">
<div class="module__field-content"><h2><span style="color: #ffffff;">Introducing East View Global Press Archive<sup>®</sup></span></h2>
<p><span class="s1">East View presents Global Press Archive (GPA), a new program that will present hundreds of global newspapers as searchable online archives, covering a diverse range of languages and countries. Many of the publications in GPA will be available as comprehensive archives for the first time and the program will collectively present immense new value for scholarly research.</span></p>
</div> </div>
</div></div><div class="col-xs-12 col-md-4">
<div class="module__links-list--simple-links">
<div class="module__inner">
<h3 class="module__title module__title--bold module__title--none">Explore GPA</h3><a class="btn btn-link" href="/resources/gpa/" target="_self">Learn More</a><a class="btn btn-link" href="/resources/gpa/crl-alliance/" target="_self">CRL Alliance</a> </div>
</div></div> </div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="module">
<div class="module__content module--inverted" id="content-1" style="background-image: url(https://www.eastview.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/nasa-53884-unsplash.png)">
<div class="container">
<div class="row">
<div class="col-xs-12">
<div class="module__inner">
<div class="row">
<div class="col-xs-12">
<h2 class="module__title module__title--bold module__title--center">Uncommon Information. Extraordinary Places.</h2><div class="module__field-content"><p class="p1" style="text-align: center;"><span class="s1">East View is dedicated to supplying uncommon information from extraordinary places, while providing exceptional service. We offer an extensive and expanding list of offerings, including online databases, print periodicals, books and microforms that extend across borders, languages and ideologies in the vernacular languages of the source. Many resources are augmented by English-language access tools and content.</span></p>
</div> </div>
</div>
